```{python}
#| label: simulador
#| echo: false
import json
from IPython.display import HTML

# Muestra: todos los KEV + una muestra de los demas (el navegador no aguanta 373k puntos)
N_MUESTRA = 20000
_sin = df[~df.in_kev].sample(n=min(N_MUESTRA, int((~df.in_kev).sum())), random_state=7)
_sim = pd.concat([_sin, df[df.in_kev]])

DATOS = {
    "x": [round(float(v), 1) for v in _sim.cvss],
    "y": [round(float(v), 5) for v in _sim.epss],
    "k": [int(v) for v in _sim.in_kev],
    "n_kev": int(df.in_kev.sum()),
    # El KEV va completo, pero el resto es una muestra: para que las cifras
    # sean comparables con la tabla, los no-KEV se extrapolan al universo real.
    "factor": float((~df.in_kev).sum()) / len(_sin),
}

TEXTOS = {c: L[c] for c in L if c.startswith("sim_")}
TEXTOS["eje_cvss"] = L["eje_cvss"]
TEXTOS["eje_epss"] = L["eje_epss"]

HTML(f"""
<div class="sim" id="sim">
  <div class="sim-controles">
    <label class="sim-dial">
      <span class="sim-lab">{L['sim_cvss']} <b id="sim-vc">9.0</b></span>
      <input type="range" id="sim-cvss" min="0" max="10.1" step="0.1" value="9">
    </label>
    <label class="sim-dial">
      <span class="sim-lab">{L['sim_epss']} <b id="sim-ve">1.00</b></span>
      <input type="range" id="sim-epss" min="0" max="1.01" step="0.01" value="1.01">
    </label>
    <label class="sim-check">
      <input type="checkbox" id="sim-kev"> {L['sim_kev']}
    </label>
  </div>

  <div class="sim-metricas">
    <div class="sim-m"><span id="sim-trabajo">—</span><small>{L['sim_m_trabajo']}</small></div>
    <div class="sim-m"><span id="sim-cobertura">—</span><small>{L['sim_m_cobertura']}</small></div>
    <div class="sim-m"><span id="sim-precision">—</span><small>{L['sim_m_precision']}</small></div>
    <div class="sim-m sim-m-alerta"><span id="sim-escapan">—</span><small>{L['sim_m_escapan']}</small></div>
  </div>

  <div id="sim-plot"></div>
  <p class="sim-nota">{L['sim_nota'].format(n=len(_sin), k=DATOS['n_kev'])}</p>
</div>

<script>
(function () {{
  const D = {json.dumps(DATOS)};
  const T = {json.dumps(TEXTOS, ensure_ascii=False)};
  const COL = {{ tp: "#3fb950", fn: "#f85149", fp: "#58a6ff", tn: "#8b949e" }};

  function esperarPlotly(cb) {{
    if (window.Plotly) return cb();
    setTimeout(function () {{ esperarPlotly(cb); }}, 120);
  }}

  esperarPlotly(function () {{
    const el = document.getElementById("sim-plot");
    const sc = document.getElementById("sim-cvss");
    const se = document.getElementById("sim-epss");
    const sk = document.getElementById("sim-kev");

    const base = {{
      mode: "markers", type: "scattergl",
      hovertemplate: "CVSS %{{x}} · EPSS %{{y:.3f}}<extra></extra>"
    }};

    function partir() {{
      const tc = parseFloat(sc.value), te = parseFloat(se.value), fk = sk.checked;
      const g = {{ tp: [[], []], fn: [[], []], fp: [[], []], tn: [[], []] }};
      let tp = 0, fp = 0, kev = 0;

      for (let i = 0; i < D.x.length; i++) {{
        const x = D.x[i], y = D.y[i], k = D.k[i];
        const rem = x >= tc || y >= te || (fk && k === 1);
        if (k) kev++;
        let c;
        if (k && rem) {{ c = "tp"; tp++; }}
        else if (k && !rem) c = "fn";
        else if (!k && rem) {{ c = "fp"; fp++; }}
        else c = "tn";
        g[c][0].push(x); g[c][1].push(y);
      }}
      // KEV completo + no-KEV extrapolados desde la muestra
      const remediados = Math.round(tp + fp * D.factor);
      return {{ g, remediados, tp, kev }};
    }}

    function pintar(primera) {{
      const r = partir();
      const traces = [
        Object.assign({{}}, base, {{
          x: r.g.tn[0], y: r.g.tn[1], name: T.sim_g_tn,
          marker: {{ size: 3, color: COL.tn, opacity: .18, symbol: "circle" }}
        }}),
        Object.assign({{}}, base, {{
          x: r.g.fp[0], y: r.g.fp[1], name: T.sim_g_fp,
          marker: {{ size: 4, color: COL.fp, opacity: .35, symbol: "circle-open" }}
        }}),
        Object.assign({{}}, base, {{
          x: r.g.tp[0], y: r.g.tp[1], name: T.sim_g_tp,
          marker: {{ size: 6, color: COL.tp, opacity: .85, symbol: "circle" }}
        }}),
        Object.assign({{}}, base, {{
          x: r.g.fn[0], y: r.g.fn[1], name: T.sim_g_fn,
          marker: {{ size: 7, color: COL.fn, opacity: .95, symbol: "x" }}
        }})
      ];

      const tc = parseFloat(sc.value), te = parseFloat(se.value);
      const C0 = window.temaColores ? window.temaColores() : {{ texto: "#e6edf3" }};
      const formas = [];
      if (tc <= 10) formas.push({{
        type: "line", x0: tc, x1: tc, y0: -0.03, y1: 1.03,
        line: {{ color: C0.texto, width: 1, dash: "dash" }}
      }});
      if (te <= 1) formas.push({{
        type: "line", x0: -0.3, x1: 10.4, y0: te, y1: te,
        line: {{ color: C0.texto, width: 1, dash: "dash" }}
      }});

      const C = window.temaColores
        ? window.temaColores()
        : {{ fondo: "#161b22", texto: "#e6edf3", linea: "#30363d" }};

      const layout = {{
        height: 520,
        paper_bgcolor: C.fondo, plot_bgcolor: C.fondo,
        font: {{ color: C.texto, family: "IBM Plex Mono, monospace", size: 12 }},
        xaxis: {{ title: {{ text: T.eje_cvss }}, range: [-0.3, 10.4], dtick: 2, gridcolor: C.linea }},
        yaxis: {{ title: {{ text: T.eje_epss }}, range: [-0.03, 1.03], gridcolor: C.linea }},
        legend: {{ orientation: "h", y: 1.15, bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)" }},
        margin: {{ l: 60, r: 30, t: 60, b: 50 }},
        shapes: formas
      }};

      if (primera) Plotly.newPlot(el, traces, layout, {{ displayModeBar: false, responsive: true }});
      else Plotly.react(el, traces, layout);

      const cob = r.kev ? (r.tp / r.kev * 100) : 0;
      const pre = r.remediados ? (r.tp / r.remediados * 100) : 0;
      document.getElementById("sim-trabajo").textContent   = r.remediados.toLocaleString("en-US");
      document.getElementById("sim-cobertura").textContent = cob.toFixed(1) + "%";
      document.getElementById("sim-precision").textContent = pre.toFixed(2) + "%";
      document.getElementById("sim-escapan").textContent   = (r.kev - r.tp).toLocaleString("en-US");
      document.getElementById("sim-vc").textContent = tc > 10 ? "—" : tc.toFixed(1);
      document.getElementById("sim-ve").textContent = te > 1 ? "—" : te.toFixed(2);
    }}

    window.addEventListener("cambio-tema", function () {{ pintar(false); }});
    [sc, se].forEach(function (s) {{ s.addEventListener("input", function () {{ pintar(false); }}); }});
    sk.addEventListener("change", function () {{ pintar(false); }});
    pintar(true);
  }});
}})();
</script>
""")
```
